about: My P1S 0.6 printer settings as differences from the default printer settings (Orca's stock "Bambu Lab P1S 0.6 nozzle" preset, pulled by orcadefaults.py); any setting not here matches the default
notes: My printer settings are the default printer settings plus the differences below. Any setting not listed here matches the default. When I change a printer setting, it gets added here.

Rows added 2026-10-03 from the "P1S 0.6mm" preset saved in pa_test.3mf and mvs_test.3mf (2026-10-02) and in rfidSpring_settings_base.json, compared with Orca 2.4.2's "Bambu Lab P1S 0.6 nozzle" profile. When and why they were made isn't recorded.

Nozzle-type note: Orca's default printer settings also say Hardened steel (checked 2026-10-10). My nozzle is confirmed hardened steel, an upgrade over the stock stainless steel P1S nozzle, so it can print abrasive filaments such as PETG Carbon Fiber.
Machine start G-code: the default is summarized as "Two 50 mm purges; big fan on for every filament; load line speed from 0.3 × 0.5; Textured PEI Z −0.04 mm"; mine differs as stated.
Machine end G-code: the default is summarized as "G1 E-0.8 F1800"; mine differs as stated.

Machine G-code.Machine start G-code: One 40 mm purge on 0.6 mm and larger nozzles; big fan (M106 P2 S100) on only for PLA, in both places; load line speed from the first layer's height × line width; Textured PEI Z −0.05 mm
